meaning: On the finite-past horn the rival fails: composing TERTIA-VIA-SUCCESSION-REQUIRES-INFINITE-PAST (imported), succession without beginning would make the past infinite, but some time up to now is first. With TERTIA-VIA-FINITE-PAST-HORN this is the dilemma of SCG I.13 [29]-[30]: on a finite past the rival is excluded and an innovating cause is required; on an infinite past (the eternity supposition) the rival stands against collective possibility, and the case relies on the arguments argued on that supposition (the prima via, which SCG I.13 runs with eternal motion). It is recorded as an attack on the rival, not a refutation, because STMT-PAST-IS-FINITE is a hypothesis.
